; a set of three readings are stored in memory
; location starting from 9050H, sort the readings 
; in descending order.


ORG 8000H
START:    LXI H, 9050H    ; Initialize HL pair to point to the start of the data
          MVI D, 00H      ; Clear D register (D acts as a swap flag: 00 = no swap, 01 = swap occurred)
          MVI C, 02H      ; Initialize counter C = N-1 = 2 (for 3 data bytes)

CHECK:    MOV A, M        ; Move current byte from memory to Accumulator
          INX H           ; Point to the next memory location
          CMP M           ; Compare Accumulator with the next byte
          JNC NEXTBYTE    ; If Accumulator >= Memory, no swap is needed (keeps descending order)

          ; --- Swap Logic (if Accumulator < Memory) ---
          MOV B, M        ; Temporary store next byte in B
          MOV M, A        ; Move smaller byte to next memory location
          DCX H           ; Move pointer back to current location
          MOV M, B        ; Move larger byte to current memory location
          INX H           ; Restore pointer to the next location
          MVI D, 01H      ; Set swap flag D = 01H to indicate a change was made

NEXTBYTE: DCR C           ; Decrement loop counter
          JNZ CHECK       ; If C != 0, repeat the comparison for the next pair

          MOV A, D        ; Move swap flag to Accumulator
          RRC             ; Rotate right to shift the LSb of D into the Carry flag
          JC START        ; If Carry = 1 (swap occurred), repeat the entire pass
          RST 1           ; Terminate the program if no swaps occurred

; --- Data Section ---
ORG 9050H
DB 87H, 56H, 75H          ; Input data
